profile.Name: Yoshinga the Slayer
profile.Personality: A fervent Okranite who greets fellow humans as holy brothers, blesses them with prayers and crushing bear hugs, and reeks of spoiled food. He hates every non-human and wants the Shek wiped out to end a war of hundreds of years.
profile.Backstory: He leads the Inhuman Hunters from Ashigakari. His faction split from the Holy Nation because it holds that a non-human cannot be reborn through labor and finds salvation only at the end of a blade. He plans to goad Esata into recklessness by seizing her daughter Seto and burning her in Okran's flame.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Pious and sermonizing, full of Okran and the Lord of Light. Calls allies "holy brother" and "Absolver of the Infernal", the Shek "horned devils", and hivers "stickmen". Claims to foresee events in the Holy Flame, though he once trips over the claim.
